subject: Mutual action plan: HealthAI capacity acceleration & handoff

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: HealthAI capacity acceleration & handoff

Hi Ellis / Sam —

Following up from our call earlier today. Per HealthAI’s timeline, you want an evaluation window that can scale into a production reservation by early September. To keep the schedule tight I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a capacity handoff path that balances a fast pilot with a staged tranche for production. Key summary: 

- Pilot (6 weeks): 8x A100-equivalent (on Dedicated) for model integration, latency tests, and evaluation prompts.
- Production tranche 1 (initial commit): 32x A100-equivalent reserved capacity for 6 months — targeted start 2025-09-01.
- Production tranche 2 (scale): add up to +64x by Q4 after evaluation metrics hit SLOs.

Lead times we typically see: Dedicated (hosted private pools) — 10–12 weeks from signed commit to capacity handoff; Private/on-prem options — 16–20 weeks (hardware procurement + network validation). We can compress the Dedicated timeline by 2–3 weeks with an early deposit and an agreed canary scope.

I’ve attached a first-pass MAP and a checklist for procurement handoff. Please review and tell us which milestones you’d like to tighten or expand. If procurement is ready, we can lock a tranche that guarantees the 9/1 start.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm evaluation cohort and preferred pilot start date (targeting Jun 23).
2) Redwood provides a signed MAP v1 and a provisional PO template.
3) Procurement issues a PO for tranche 1 or an initial deposit to secure a commit window.

Thanks — happy to run through line-by-line tomorrow.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Ellis —

Short answers: 
- Dedicated lead time if commit by 2025-07-03: typically 10–12 weeks (target handoff window 2025-09-11 to 2025-09-25). If you provide a 30% deposit we can prioritize your tranche and target the earlier end of that range (09/11).
- Pilot at 4x is possible for a lightweight smoke test; for representative throughput/latency numbers we recommend 8x. We can do a 2-week smoke on 4x then expand to 8x for deeper evaluation.
- Security artifacts: Redwood will need the completed vendor intake + any specific data processing boundaries; for our SOC2 evidence we can provide our latest SOC2 Type II report and the security appendix. Marissa will include the procurement pack.

High-level proposed MAP milestones (draft):
A) Week 0 (commit): Sign MAP & PO, initial deposit (30%).
B) Week 1–2 (kickoff): Access & credentials, onboarding checklist, dataset transfer plan (if needed).
C) Weeks 3–8 (pilot): 8x Dedicated for evaluation, weekly syncs, run eval prompt suite.
D) Week 9 (decision): Production commit/scale based on eval metrics; schedule tranche handoff.

I attached a timeboxed MAP and a simple cost/throughput matrix so you can see unit economics for 4x/8x/32x.

—
Rishi
